messages:
julia.csm: Heads up — Coriant Labs (acct: COR-421) has a live EU demo next Tue and asked for a temporary regional tweak: increase QPS on eu-west-2 for route /cor/v1/respond, add their callback CIDR to the egress allowlist, and pin regional routing. Can we discuss operational constraints?
sam-ops: thanks. Rough numbers?
julia.csm: They expect spikes up to ~450 QPS sustained for ~2.5 hrs, with bursts to 700 QPS. TTL requested 48h (start + auto-revoke). Also they'd like `X-Coriant-Env: demo` header added for their logging.
nima-net: need exact CIDR and whether callbacks originate from peered or customer-managed infra. Also header injection at edge is fine but we'll need route name.
julia.csm: CIDR is 198.51.100.0/24, callbacks from their peered proxy. Route is `/cor/v1/respond`.
rachel-aml: performance note — for low-latency demos we should enable KV cache priming and set a short warmup for the most common prompt shapes. I can spin up a perf job after the window to capture quality metrics.
ash-support: plan I propose: 1) create ephemeral policy cor-demo-eu-328765 2) add 198.51.100.0/24 to proxy-egress-allowlist 3) add a region pin eu-west-2 for the route 4) route header injection `X-Coriant-Env: demo` 5) set QPS=450, burst=700, duration=2.5h, TTL=48h 6) canary 3% nodes for 5m then full roll 7) rollback thresholds: error_rate>4% or p95>350ms -> revert to baseline variant.
sam-ops: +1. Add safety hooks: an automatic model fallback to lite-variant (opt-lite) and a notification to #customer-ops with @oncall ping if thresholds hit. Also enforce rate-limit windowing to avoid token storms.
nash-support: doing that. Draft config snippet: ```json
{
  "org": "COR-421",
  "route": "/cor/v1/respond",
  "region": "eu-west-2",
  "qps": 450,
  "burst_qps": 700,
  "duration_hours": "2.5",
  "ttl_hours": "48",
  "egress_cidrs": ["198.51.100.0/24"],
  "headers": {"X-Coriant-Env": "demo"},
  "canary": {"percent": 3, "duration_minutes": 5},
  "rollback_on": {"error_rate_pct": 4, "p95_latency_ms": 350},
  "fallback_model": "opt-lite"
}
```
julia.csm: this looks good. Note: renewal check — Coriant's contract upsell window opens in 5 weeks; if the demo drives usage, we should follow up with a tailored package. I'll prep a short ROI note.
rachel-aml: I'll enable priming and run a quick eval immediately after the demo to make sure quality didn't regress.
sam-ops: ash — can you own scheduling the change and the on-call handoff? Put a roll-back playbook in the thread.
ash-support: scheduled and posted to #customer-ops. deploy-bot: change cor-demo-eu-328765 created by ash-support. Canary: 3% nodes starting 3287720000 for 5m. Auto-revoke after 48h. Rollback thresholds and fallback model configured.
julia.csm: thanks everyone — I'll share the header/ingress docs with Coriant and confirm callback readiness. :rocket:
